provenance.path_note: Absolute paths above record historical commands and working directories only; they are ephemeral and are not durable artifact locations.
notes: Baseline is origin/main plus the identical harness only.
Candidate archive commit has the exact runtime, native, and harness inputs used by the default AOT bundle; its additional test files do not enter the bundle.

measurement_limitations.reason: On Dart VM 3.12.2, Duration(microseconds: 16667) was truncated to a 16 ms timer while the collected harness divided elapsed time by the requested 16,667 us. Later callbacks may also arrive less than one period apart, so aggregate callback count can hide an earlier long gap.
measurement_limitations.retained_raw_field_policy: The original frame_period_us, expected_frames, missed_frames, and callback_lateness fields remain verbatim inside runs for log fidelity but are not interpreted.
measurement_limitations.retained_harness_fix: Future runs request an explicit 16 ms heartbeat and emit complete callback_gaps_us plus long_gap_missed_periods_lower_bound instead of requested-period expected-minus-callback and tick-based lateness fields.

order_paired_comparison.comparison: process medians; lower is better for latency and higher is better for jitter throughput
